Field boundaries in one step

Source: R/workflow.R
fb_fields.Rd

Runs the complete workflow on a stack: TBC edge and cropland maps from a model, optional fusion with deep-model probabilities, field objects and polygons.

Usage

fb_fields(
  stack,
  model = fb_model_pretrained("general"),
  dl = NULL,
  fusion = if (is.null(dl)) NULL else fb_model_pretrained("general", "fusion"),
  thresholds = NULL,
  polygons = TRUE,
  threads = 1L
)

Arguments

stack

An fb_stack.

model

An fb_model (default: the pretrained "general" model).

dl

Optional deep-model probabilities (background, field, boundary), for example from fb_prue_predict(), on the grid of stack.

fusion

An fb_fusion model, used when dl is given (default: the pretrained "general" fusion).

thresholds

Delineation thresholds; by default those stored with the model (or the fusion, when dl is given).

polygons

Return polygons as well as rasters.

threads

Number of threads for the cropland model.

Value

A list with maps (edge and cropland), fields (field objects) and, if requested, polygons (sf).

Examples

s <- fb_example_stack("moghan")
res <- fb_fields(s)
res$polygons
